name: Daily journal
summary: Keep a daily journal with prompts by week or free writing, at the time you choose.

plan_blueprint.calendar: A daily reminder at the chosen time and a monthly look-back.

approach_variants.habit: Journal right after an existing habit (morning coffee, brushing teeth); streak of entries.
approach_variants.willpower: Challenge: 30 days in a row with a countdown.
approach_variants.time: A fixed daily calendar block; weekly review of time spent.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen treat after each month of entries.
approach_variants.resource: First day sets up a notebook or note app and a quiet spot.

guardrails: Journaling prompts are for reflection, not therapy. If you're struggling, reach out to a professional or a support line.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: Missed days aren't counted against you; the next prompt continues where you left off.
